```{r setup}
#! include: false

library(cowplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

# Inputs: results/f1_error_estimation/<run>/ (scripts/f1_error_estimation.smk)
# GlobDB r232 metapackage v4 run (results/species_estimation/20260704)
run_date <- Sys.getenv("F1_RUN_DATE", "20261111")
input_dir <- Sys.getenv("F1_INPUT_DIR", here("results", "f1_error_estimation", run_date))
output_dir <- Sys.getenv("F1_OUTPUT_DIR", here("results", "f1_error_estimation_qmd", run_date))
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Paul Tol's vibrant palette - colourblind friendly
vibrant_colours <- c("#CC3311", "#0077BB", "#009988", "#EE3377", "#EE7733", "#33BBEE")
# Paul Tol's bright palette - colourblind friendly
bright_colours <- c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833", "#CCBB44", "#66CCEE", "#AA3377", "#BBBBBB")

f_levels <- c("f1", "f2", "f3", "f4-9", "f10-99", "f100+")
scope_labels <- c(all = "All samples", human_gut = "Human gut")
statistic_labels <- c(codon_position = "Codon position 3", synonymous = "Synonymous", stop_codon = "Stop gain")
```

```{r wrangling}
signature <- read_tsv(file.path(input_dir, "collated_signature.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
estimates <- bind_rows(
  read_tsv(file.path(input_dir, "error_estimates.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
  read_tsv(file.path(input_dir, "error_estimates_all_reference.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
) %>%
  # all-samples scope is identical under both references; keep one
  filter(!(scope == "all" & reference == "all"))

# Observed mismatch rates per marker: pooled over parent classes
observed <- signature %>%
  group_by(scope, marker, f_class, single_read) %>%
  summarise(across(c(n_pairs, n_single_nt, pos3, syn, stop, exp_syn, exp_stop), sum), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_single_nt > 0) %>%
  transmute(
    scope, marker, f_class, single_read, n_pairs, n_single_nt,
    `Codon position 3` = pos3 / n_single_nt,
    Synonymous = syn / n_single_nt,
    `Stop gain` = stop / n_single_nt,
    expected_codon_position = 1 / 3,
    expected_synonymous = exp_syn / n_single_nt,
    expected_stop = exp_stop / n_single_nt
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(`Codon position 3`, Synonymous, `Stop gain`), names_to = "statistic", values_to = "rate") %>%
  mutate(
    f_class = factor(f_class, levels = f_levels),
    scope = factor(scope_labels[scope], levels = scope_labels),
    read_type = if_else(single_read, "Single-read", "Multi-read"),
    statistic = factor(statistic, levels = statistic_labels)
  )
```

## Error rates and error estimates

```{r error-estimates-function}
error_estimates_figure <- function(observed, estimates, signature) {
  # a) observed mismatch rates; dotted line = expectation under uniform random substitution
  expected <- signature %>%
    filter(n_single_nt > 0) %>%
    summarise(syn = sum(exp_syn) / sum(n_single_nt), stop = sum(exp_stop) / sum(n_single_nt))
  expectation <- tibble(
    statistic = factor(statistic_labels[c("codon_position", "synonymous", "stop_codon")], levels = statistic_labels),
    expected = c(1 / 3, expected$syn, expected$stop)
  )

  plot_a <- observed %>%
    ggplot(aes(f_class, rate, colour = read_type)) +
    geom_hline(data = expectation, aes(yintercept = expected), linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey30") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.7), alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = read_type), fun = median, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 6,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
    facet_grid(statistic ~ scope, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Single-read" = vibrant_colours[1], "Multi-read" = vibrant_colours[2])) +
    labs(x = "Sample-count class", y = "Fraction of 1-nt codon changes", colour = NULL) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  # b) estimated error fraction, single-read sequences, by estimator and reference
  panel_labels <- c(
    "all/same_scope" = "All samples",
    "human_gut/same_scope" = "Human gut\n(own f100+ reference)",
    "human_gut/all" = "Human gut\n(all-sample f100+ reference)"
  )
  est <- estimates %>%
    filter(parent_class == "all", single_read, f_class %in% c("f1", "f2", "f3", "f4-9")) %>%
    mutate(
      panel = factor(panel_labels[paste(scope, reference, sep = "/")], levels = panel_labels),
      f_class = factor(f_class, levels = f_levels),
      statistic = factor(statistic_labels[statistic], levels = statistic_labels)
    )

  plot_b <- est %>%
    ggplot(aes(f_class, error_fraction, colour = statistic)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 1), colour = "grey80") +
    geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.7), alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
    stat_summary(aes(group = statistic), fun = median, geom = "point", shape = 95, size = 6,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
    facet_wrap(~panel, nrow = 1) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.1, 1.1)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(bright_colours[c(1, 2, 3)], statistic_labels)) +
    labs(x = "Sample-count class", y = "Estimated error fraction", colour = NULL) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(legend.position = "top")

  list(
    plot = plot_grid(plot_a, plot_b, ncol = 1, labels = c("a", "b"), rel_heights = c(1.6, 1)),
    data_a = observed %>% select(-starts_with("expected")),
    data_b = est
  )
}
```

```{r error-estimates}
output_subdir <- file.path(output_dir, "error_estimates")
dir.create(output_subdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

result <- error_estimates_figure(observed, estimates, signature)
figure_name <- "figure_S11_f1_error_estimates"
for (ext in c("png", "pdf", "svg")) {
  ggsave(file.path(output_subdir, str_c(figure_name, ".", ext)), result$plot, width = 11, height = 11)
}
write_tsv(result$data_a, file.path(output_subdir, str_c(figure_name, "_observed.tsv")))
write_tsv(result$data_b, file.path(output_subdir, str_c(figure_name, "_estimates.tsv")))

# n and median estimates per class (pooled over markers)
result$data_b %>%
  group_by(panel, f_class, statistic) %>%
  summarise(
    n_markers = n(), n_single_nt = sum(n_single_nt),
    median_error_fraction = median(error_fraction), min = min(error_fraction), max = max(error_fraction),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  write_tsv(file.path(output_subdir, "error_estimates_stats.tsv"))

result$plot
```
